ctx.x: Trumpet was Rostelle Reese. So anyway, they are trying something out with this band. Well, they had billed Kirby like a circus around there, on the air with his records and this-that-and-the-other, and consequently, the place was packed and jammed with people. Packed! Well, ...(?)... two kids in the country, man. I mean, one of them was 23 years old, the other was 25 -- nothing but kids. Because the old man had run the bar and never had over three customers in it, but he was a wealthy man. He was retiring, you…
But here's the kids up there, the place is packed full of people. They don't know what to do. They've got this big bar, and they've got a big tray on the end of the bar,
